review: Read-only source audit by a separate agent, cited source independently reopened by root. No new correctness bug established.

findings.title: Reuse the backend dependency collector result after proving canonical provenance
findings.impact: A native normalization pass over every dependency remains on each successful analysis; validation and errors have corresponding passes.
findings.confidence: HIGH repeated work; MED safe removal pending lifecycle/alias characterization
findings.scope: Keep raw request, compiler membership and missing/disk path boundaries. Prove canonical membership provenance at both collection callers, then reuse fresh sorted output in success/error/validation. No new cache or graph structure.
findings.verification: Real junction/symlink transitive imports plus unrelated controls, exact canonical result arrays, edit/delete/recreate, alias retarget or config/reference switch, both modes, persistent validation/error paths, fresh semantic oracles and paired unprofiled measurement.

findings.title: Avoid immediately repeated normalization during Program membership synchronization
findings.impact: Program/config collectors normalize arrays that syncFiles immediately normalizes again. Program-identity guard limits this cost.
findings.risk: LOW when limited to adjacent canonical producers; MED if raw-input normalization is broadly removed
findings.scope: Keep a single normalization boundary and independent sorted Set snapshots; retain normalization for raw initial project files. Profile attribution must justify priority.

findings.title: Check existence before normalizing relative candidates that will be discarded
findings.impact: Existing candidates are physically normalized immediately before being rejected by existsSync. Missing candidates still need physical identity.
findings.confidence: HIGH repeated work; measurement needed for significance
findings.scope: Preserve all extension/index candidates, JavaScript substitution and missing-parent canonicalization. Characterize mixed existing/aliased/missing imports and exact HMR after creation.

findings.title: Treat semantic dependency narrowing as a separate design investigation
findings.impact: Salt augmentation imports Props through the core barrel, creating conservative reachability from every target to core. Fewer dependent transforms could reduce many types of work.
findings.scope: Do not drop shared ambient seeds or infer independence from the 7/33 changed outputs. Characterize augmentation/barrel/cycle/merged declarations and consecutive effective edits against full fresh metadata before proposing a narrowing rule.

retainedByDesign.watchFilesExistenceChecks: Current analysis and accepted persistent entries may contain missing paths; existence and delete/recreate behavior need preservation. A retained already-watched Set would add lifecycle state without a proven design.
